english_policy.notes.2: The apply page states IELTS 7.0 and new-scale TOEFL section minima. The complete age/waiver rule was not captured, so English eligibility is not automatically passed.

fact_summary: The two-semester CS MEng has optional/no-impact GRE, technical preparation and degree requirements. Partial English thresholds, transcript equivalency and age/waiver conditions are not treated as a complete eligibility rule.
